_meta.purpose: Three CIL mines with lease polygons, loaded into PostGIS as GEOMETRY(Polygon,4326).
_meta.honesty_note: Polygons are ILLUSTRATIVE rectangles placed at each mine's approximate real coordinates. They are not surveyed lease boundaries — no public authoritative GeoJSON of CIL lease boundaries was available. Say 'representative boundary' to a judge, never 'the actual lease'. The geometry pipeline (ST_Contains, ST_Difference, ST_Area) is real; only these coordinates are stand-ins.
_meta.coordinate_order: GeoJSON is [longitude, latitude]. Rings close by repeating the first point.

mines.name: Gevra OC
mines.note: Korba, Chhattisgarh. One of India's largest opencast mines. Used for the geo-compliance and boundary-breach demo.

excavation_geom.note: Deliberately crosses the eastern boundary. ST_Difference against lease_geom yields the area outside — this is demo moment 4.

mines.name: Jhanjra UG
mines.note: Raniganj coalfield, West Bengal. Underground — carries the ventilation, strata and rescue duties, and the offline-capture demo.

mines.name: Bhubaneswari OC
mines.note: Talcher coalfield, Odisha. Third mine so the regulator role has more than one to compare.

sensor_thresholds._note: Static threshold table. Detection is a rolling mean plus z-score against these — arithmetic, not a model. Each threshold names the clause it protects, which is what makes a breach a compliance alert.
